page.overview:
Who is Punishment Devil?

The の|Batsu no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of punishment.

Because of the circumstances in which the Punishment Devil made its only appearance in one gigantic amalgamation of several Devils, it is rather difficult to pinpoint exactly how it looks. They are a being of what may be several conjoined humanoid bodies with distorted faces, each carrying a different weapon. Outside of the bodies they have several conjoined arms on a opened mouth that looks very similar to the mouth of Snake Devil. In the coloured manga the inner body is a very light brown or brownish-yellow and the outer body with the conjoined arms on a mouth have a bolder yellow.

The Punishment Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point Yutaro Kurose and Michiko Tendo made a contract with the Punishment Devil, for an unknown price.
